Subject: Trade pixels for pizza? Design team lunch this Friday 🍕🎨

Hi team —

Who’s up for swapping screens for sandwiches this Friday? Let’s get together for lunch at 12:30 PM in the breakout area (or we can head to a nearby spot if more people prefer going out). I’m thinking a relaxed mix — pizza, bowls, and options for vegetarian/vegan/gluten-free folks.

Quick RSVP please:
- Reply by Wednesday EOD if you’re coming
- Tell me any dietary restrictions
- Say whether you’d rather eat in or go out

I can handle ordering/reservations if that works for everyone. Also: design critiques are strictly forbidden during dessert. 😉

Cheers,
[Your Name]

Note: This is a draft only — I haven’t sent it. Tell me if you want any changes or if I should send it.
